messages.subject: Missing cells
parts:
Dear Mike,

I tried to run an ANOVA anaylsis on a mixed design, but keep getting
the message like this "ezANOVA_main(data = data, dv = dv, wid = wid,
within = within, :
One or more cells is missing data. Try using ezDesign() to check
your data."

I also tried ezDesign , but no missing cells were found. Apologize if
this is a FAQ question.

Here is my command:
sequential_effect_general_Exp1vs2 = ezANOVA(
data = Seqface_data_Exp1vs2
, dv = .(identification)
, wid = .(sub)
, within = .(preceding)
, between = .(exp)
)

print(sequential_effect_general_Exp1vs2)

ezDesign(
Seqface_data_Exp1vs2
, x = .(exp)
, y = .(sub)
, col = .(preceding)
